skills.name: 梦愈净瑕
skills.desc:
普攻
连续短按或按住普攻进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成衍射伤害。

空中攻击
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成衍射伤害。

闪避反击
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成衍射伤害。施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻第4段。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} repeatedly or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.

Dodge Counter
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.

skills.name: 幻梦调和
skills.desc:
共鸣技能·梦魇调和
莉莉重击初始为重击·编织的梦之童话。重击为重击·编织的梦之童话时，短按共鸣技能，对周围目标造成衍射伤害。技能后重击切换至重击·编织的梦之魇影。
该技能与共鸣技能·美梦调和共享冷却时间。

共鸣技能·美梦调和
重击为重击·编织的梦之魇影时，短按共鸣技能，对周围目标造成衍射伤害。技能后重击切换至重击·编织的梦之童话。
该技能与共鸣技能·梦魇调和共享冷却时间。
skills.descEn:
Resonance Skill - Nightmare Blend
Lily starts with Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale by default. When Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale is active, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill to deal Spectro DMG to nearby targets, then switch to Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Resonance Skill - Reverie Blend.

Resonance Skill - Reverie Blend
When Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm is active, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill to deal Spectro DMG to nearby targets, then switch to Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Resonance Skill - Nightmare Blend.

skills.name: 坠于幻梦摇篮
skills.desc:
施放时，莉莉进入梦乡，同时获得【摇篮的安魂语】。
施放时，获得一个自身生命上限100%的护盾，持续4秒，该护盾在切换至其他角色时不会继承。
可在低空中施放。

梦乡
持续50秒。莉莉进入梦乡期间，每3秒为附近队伍中登场角色回复生命值，梦乡期间移动可以控制梦缚进行攻击，对周围的目标造成衍射伤害，梦缚攻击期间每5秒将会牵引一定范围内的目标，梦缚在停止移动10秒后将会停止攻击。梦乡期间再次短按共鸣解放可以提前结束梦乡。
莉莉进入梦乡期间，队伍中除莉莉以外的角色施放变奏技能时，牵引一定范围内的目标，每10秒可触发1次。莉莉在梦乡期间免疫受击，受到的伤害降低50%。
梦乡期间，切换其他角色登场后，莉莉将持续在场，同时停止梦缚攻击。梦乡结束后莉莉将会离场，距离队伍中登场角色过远莉莉也会提前离场。莉莉施放变奏技能·永绽会提前打断梦乡。

摇篮的安魂语
持续25秒。持续期间，当队伍中除莉莉以外的角色施放变奏技能时，获取1层【梦芳】，莉莉登场时移除摇篮的安魂语。

梦芳
上限4层。每层提升队伍中所有角色攻击：莉莉自身共鸣效率大于190%时，每超过1%的共鸣效率计算为0.1%的攻击提升，上限7%。莉莉登场时移除该效果，摇篮的安魂语持续时间结束时，也会移除该效果。
skills.descEn:
Casting this skill sends Lily into Slumberland and grants her Cradle Lullaby.
Casting this skill also grants Lily a Shield equal to 100% of her Max HP for 4s. This Shield does not carry over to the incoming Resonator.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Slumberland
Lasts for 50s. When Lily is in Slumberland, she heals the nearby active Resonator every 3s. During Slumberland, use directional input to command Dreambind to attack, dealing Spectro DMG to nearby targets. Dreambind pulls in targets within a certain range every 5s while attacking, and stops attacking 10s after movement stops. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Liberation again during Slumberland to end it early.
When Lily is in Slumberland and a Resonator in the team other than Lily casts Intro Skill, targets within a certain range are pulled in. This effect can be triggered once every 10s. Lily is immune to interruption during Slumberland and takes 50% less DMG.
Switching to another Resonator during Slumberland keeps Lily on the field but stops the attacks of Dreambind. Lily leaves the field when Slumberland ends, or earlier if she gets too far from the active Resonator. Casting Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom also ends Slumberland immediately.

Cradle Lullaby
Lasts for 25s. While this effect is active, each Intro Skill cast by a Resonator in the team other than Lily grants 1 stack of Dream Aroma. Cradle Lullaby is removed when Lily is the incoming Resonator.

Dream Aroma
Stacks up to 4 times. Each stack increases the ATK of all Resonators in the team by 0.1% for every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 190%, up to 7%. This effect is removed when Lily is the incoming Resonator or when Cradle Lullaby ends.

skills.name: 织梦的芬芳
skills.desc:
施放变奏技能·永绽时，额外回复10点协奏能量，每20秒可触发1次。
施放重击·梦之童话的落幕和重击·梦之魇影的终结时，额外回复15点协奏能量，每20秒可触发1次。
skills.descEn:
Casting Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom additionally restores 10 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s.
Casting Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale or Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End additionally restores 15 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s.

skills.name: 献花予你
skills.desc:
当附近队伍中登场角色生命值不低于50%时，莉莉为其提供10%伤害减免。
队伍中有角色受到致死伤害时，此次伤害不会使该角色倒下，并获得基于莉莉10%生命上限的护盾，护盾持续10秒，该效果每5分钟可触发1次。
施放重击·梦之童话的落幕和重击·梦之魇影的终结时，莉莉获得花束的祝福。

花束的祝福
持续60秒。队伍中的存活角色当前生命值低于生命上限的50%时，回复该角色生命上限50%的生命值，并移除花束的祝福，该效果每120秒可触发1次。
skills.descEn:
While a nearby active Resonator has 50% or more HP, Lily grants them 10% DMG Reduction.
When a Resonator in the team takes a fatal blow, they will not fall and will instead gain a Shield equal to 10% of Lily's Max HP for 10s. This effect can be triggered once every 5 min.
Casting Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale or Enhanced Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End grants Floral Blessing to Resonators in the team.

Floral Blessing
Lasts for 60s. When the HP of a Resonator in the team is below 50% of their Max HP, restore 50% of their Max HP and remove Floral Blessing. This effect can be triggered once every 120s.

skills.name: 绮梦绽香
skills.desc:
初绽
攻击目标，造成衍射伤害，施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻第3段。

永绽
施放共鸣解放·坠于幻梦摇篮后，莉莉的下一次变奏技能初绽替换为变奏技能永绽。施放时攻击目标，造成衍射伤害。
莉莉自身共鸣效率大于100%时，每超过1%的共鸣效率使该技能造成伤害的暴击提升0.5%，上限80%，并使造成的暴击伤害提升1%，上限160%。
施放该技能后，获得幽梦芳香，持续8秒。施放重击·编织的梦之童话或重击·编织的梦之魇影时，可以消耗幽梦芳香，并额外获得100点梦铃的祷声。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻第3段。
skills.descEn:
First Bloom
Attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

Eternal Bloom
After casting Resonance Liberation - Into the Dream Cradle, Lily's next Intro Skill First Bloom is replaced with Eternal Bloom. When cast, it attacks the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
For every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, this skill gains 0.5% Crit. Rate, up to 80%, and 1% Crit. DMG, up to 160%.
Casting the skill grants Deep Dream Fragrance for 8s. Casting Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale or Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm consumes Deep Dream Fragrance to additionally grant 100 points of Dreambell Chime.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

skills.name: 花满梦土
skills.desc:
绮梦香息
上限300点。
普攻、空中攻击和闪避反击造成伤害时，回复绮梦香息。
施放共鸣技能·美梦调和和共鸣技能·梦魇调和后，回复130点绮梦香息。
施放变奏技能·永绽时，回复130点绮梦香息。

梦铃的祷声
上限300点。
重击·编织的梦之童话、重击·编织的梦之魇影期间可持续获得。未被消耗的梦铃的祷声会被转换为同等值的绮梦香息。

重击·编织的梦之童话
绮梦香息满时，长按普攻，施放重击·编织的梦之童话，消耗全部绮梦香息，并获得1层梦之庇佑。技能期间莉莉牵引周围的目标，持续对周围目标造成衍射伤害，每秒为队伍中所有角色回复生命值，持续2秒。
施放重击·编织的梦之童话时，莉莉获得祈梦之愿。
施放重击·编织的梦之童话期间切换至其他角色则提前退出。
技能期间莉莉持续获得梦铃的祷声，并开始持续回复协奏能量，至多回复30点。
梦铃的祷声达到300点时，可以短按或按住普攻提前打断重击·编织的梦之童话，施放重击·梦之童话的落幕。重击·编织的梦之童话结束后，将会自动施放重击·梦之童话的落幕。施放重击·梦之童话的落幕后，消耗所有梦铃的祷声。

重击·梦之童话的落幕
攻击范围内的目标，造成衍射伤害。
莉莉自身共鸣效率大于100%时，每超过1%的共鸣效率使该技能造成伤害的暴击提升0.5%，上限80%，并使造成的暴击伤害提升1%，上限160%。
施放该技能期间，自身获得香尘，持续6秒。施放延奏技能时，消耗香尘并给队伍中的角色添加【斑白眠梦】，每20秒可触发1次。
施放该技能期间，不能切换角色。

重击·编织的梦之魇影
绮梦香息满时，长按普攻，施放重击·编织的梦之魇影，消耗全部绮梦香息，并获得1层梦之庇佑。技能期间莉莉持续牵引周围的目标，对周围目标造成衍射伤害，每秒为队伍中所有角色回复生命值，持续2秒。
施放重击·编织的梦之魇影时，莉莉获得祈梦之愿。
施放重击·编织的梦之魇影期间切换至其他角色则提前退出。
技能期间莉莉持续获得梦铃的祷声，并开始持续回复协奏能量，至多回复30点。
梦铃的祷声达到300点时，可以短按或按住普攻提前打断重击·编织的梦之魇影，施放重击·梦之魇影的终结。重击·编织的梦之魇影结束后，将会自动施放重击·梦之魇影的终结。施放重击·梦之魇影的终结后，消耗所有梦铃的祷声。

重击·梦之魇影的终结
攻击范围内的目标，造成衍射伤害。
莉莉自身共鸣效率大于100%时，每超过1%的共鸣效率使该技能造成伤害的暴击提升0.5%，上限80%，并使造成的暴击伤害提升1%，上限160%。
施放该技能期间，自身获得香尘，持续6秒。施放延奏技能时，消耗香尘并给队伍中的角色添加【斑白眠梦】，每20秒可触发1次。
施放该技能期间，不能切换角色。

斑白眠梦
持续30秒。
若该角色为队伍中登场角色且可响应同奏时，队伍每拥有1层【同奏增益】，该角色提升攻击，莉莉自身共鸣效率大于190%时，每超过1%的共鸣效率计算为0.1%的攻击提升，上限7%，最多对4层【同奏增益】生效。
队伍中的登场角色提升声骸技能暴击和声骸技能暴击伤害，莉莉的共鸣效率大于190%时，每超过0.7%的共鸣效率计算为0.1%的声骸暴击提升，上限10%；每超过0.7%的共鸣效率计算为0.2%的声骸暴击伤害提升，上限20%。
队伍中所有角色抗打断提升。

梦之庇佑
施放重击·编织的梦之童话或重击·编织的梦之魇影时，获得1层梦之庇佑。梦之庇佑上限为1层。重击·梦之童话的落幕或重击·梦之魇影的终结结束时，移除梦之庇佑。重击·编织的梦之童话或重击·编织的梦之魇影被打断时，也会移除梦之庇佑。受到敌方怪物攻击造成的伤害时，可消耗1层梦之庇佑，使自身免疫打断且受到伤害降低60%，持续1秒。该效果每秒可触发1次。

祈梦之愿
每25秒可获得1次。
拥有祈梦之愿时，此次重击·编织的梦之童话或重击·编织的梦之魇影消耗祈梦之愿将提供的治疗量提升400%。
skills.descEn:
Dream Perfume
Can hold up to 300 points.
Basic Attack, Mid-air Attack, and Dodge Counter restore Dream Perfume when dealing damage.
Casting Resonance Skill - Reverie Blend or Resonance Skill - Nightmare Blend restores 130 points of Dream Perfume.
Casting Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom restores 130 points of Dream Perfume.

Dreambell Chime
Can hold up to 300 points.
Can be gained continuously during Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale and Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm. Any unconsumed Dreambell Chime will be converted into an equal amount of Dream Perfume.

Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale
When Dream Perfume is full, hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale, consuming all Dream Perfume to grant 1 stack of Dream Shelter. During the skill, Lily pulls in nearby targets and continuously deals Spectro DMG to them. She also heals all Resonators in the team every second for 2s.
Casting Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale grants Lily Wish of Praying Dream.
Switching to another Resonator during Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale ends the skills immediately.
Lily continuously gains Dreambell Chime and Concerto Energy (up to 30 points) during the skill.
When Dreambell Chime reaches 300 points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack to end the skill immediately and cast Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale. Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale is automatically cast at the end of Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale. Casting Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale consumes all Dreambell Chime.

Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale
Attack targets within range, dealing Spectro DMG.
For every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, this skill gains 0.5% Crit. Rate, up to 80%, and 1% Crit. DMG, up to 160%.
Lily gains Sillage for 6s while casting this skill. Casting Outro Skill consumes Sillage and grants Silvered Dream to Resonators in the team. This effect can be triggered once every 20s.
Lily cannot be switched off while casting this skill.

Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm
When Dream Perfume is full, hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm, consuming all Dream Perfume to grant 1 stack of Dream Shelter. During the skill, Lily pulls in nearby targets and continuously deals Spectro DMG to them. She also heals all Resonators in the team every second for 2s.
Casting Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm grants Lily Wish of Praying Dream.
Switching to another Resonator during Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm ends the skill immediately.
Lily continuously gains Dreambell Chime and Concerto Energy (up to 30 points) during the skill.
When Dreambell Chime reaches 300 points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack to end the skill immediately and cast Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End. Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End is automatically cast at the end of Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm. Casting Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End consumes all Dreambell Chime.

Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End
Attack targets within range, dealing Spectro DMG.
For every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, this skill gains 0.5% Crit. Rate, up to 80%, and 1% Crit. DMG, up to 160%.
Lily gains Sillage for 6s while casting this skill. Casting Outro Skill consumes Sillage and grants Silvered Dream to Resonators in the team. This effect can be triggered once every 20s.
Lily cannot be switched off while casting this skill.

Silvered Dream
Lasts for 30s.
When the Resonator with this effect is the active Resonator and can trigger Unison Response, each stack of Unison Boon on the team increases their ATK by 0.1% for every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 190%, up to 7%, counting up to 4 stacks of Unison Boon.
The active Resonator's Echo Skill Crit. Rate and Echo Skill Crit. DMG are increased. Every 0.7% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 190% increases Echo Skill Crit. Rate by 0.1%, up to 10%. Every 0.7% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 190% increases Echo Skill Crit. DMG by 0.2%, up to 20%.
All Resonators in the team gain increased resistance to interruption.

Dream Shelter
Casting Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale or Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm grants 1 stack of Dream Shelter, stacking up to 1 time. Dream Shelter is removed when Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale or Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End ends, or when Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale or Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm is interrupted. Receiving damage from an enemy target consumes 1 stack of Dream Shelter to grant Lily immunity to interruption and reduce the DMG taken by 60% for 1s. This effect can be triggered once every 1s.

Wish of Praying Dream
Can be gained once every 25s.
When Lily has Wish of Praying Dream, the current Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale or Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm consumes Wish of Praying Dream to increase the skill's healing by 400%.

skills.name: 巧手烹调
skills.desc: 当前角色烹饪时有概率产出特色料理
skills.descEn: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

skills.name: 熏香绽放
skills.desc: 队伍中的角色全伤害加深25%，持续30秒。
skills.descEn: Resonators in the team gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 30s.

skills.name: 谐度破坏·佩枪
skills.desc: 目标【偏谐值】满时，可对其施放【谐度破坏】。
skills.descEn: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.

inherents.name: 织梦的芬芳
inherents.desc:
施放变奏技能·永绽时，额外回复10点协奏能量，每20秒可触发1次。
施放重击·梦之童话的落幕和重击·梦之魇影的终结时，额外回复15点协奏能量，每20秒可触发1次。

inherents.name: 献花予你
inherents.desc:
当附近队伍中登场角色生命值不低于50%时，莉莉为其提供10%伤害减免。
队伍中有角色受到致死伤害时，此次伤害不会使该角色倒下，并获得基于莉莉10%生命上限的护盾，护盾持续10秒，该效果每5分钟可触发1次。
施放重击·梦之童话的落幕和重击·梦之魇影的终结时，莉莉获得花束的祝福。

花束的祝福
持续60秒。队伍中的存活角色当前生命值低于生命上限的50%时，回复该角色生命上限50%的生命值，并移除花束的祝福，该效果每120秒可触发1次。

chains.name: 看啊，那梦的废墟生出的白花
chains.nameEn: Look, White Flowers from the Ruins of Dreams
chains.desc:
莉莉施放重击·编织的梦之童话、重击·编织的梦之魇影、重击·梦之童话的落幕和重击·梦之魇影的终结期间免疫打断。
【摇篮的安魂语】持续期间，当队伍中除莉莉以外的角色施放变奏技能时，获取【梦芳】的层数提升至2层。
chains.descEn:
Lily is immune to interruption while casting Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale, Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm, Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale, or Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End.
While Cradle Lullaby is active, each Intro Skill cast by a Resonator in the team other than Lily now grants 2 stacks of Dream Aroma.

chains.name: 听啊，那梦摇篮颂唱的安魂曲
chains.nameEn: Listen, a Requiem from the Dream Cradle
chains.desc: 【摇篮的安魂语】持续期间，当队伍中除莉莉以外的角色施放变奏技能时，每层【梦芳】额外提升2%暴击和6%暴击伤害。
chains.descEn: While Cradle Lullaby is active, when a Resonator in the team other than Lily casts an Intro Skill, each stack of Dream Aroma additionally increases Crit. Rate by 2% and Crit. DMG by 6%.

chains.name: 愿您的灵魂不再迷惘
chains.nameEn: May Your Soul Wander No More
chains.desc:
莉莉进入战斗状态时，额外获得170点【绮梦香息】，该效果每12秒可触发一次。莉莉施放变奏技能·永绽造成伤害时，额外获得170点【绮梦香息】。
莉莉施放共鸣解放·坠于幻梦摇篮时，额外回复10点协奏能量。
莉莉施放重击·梦之童话的落幕和重击·梦之魇影的终结造成伤害时，额外回复10点共鸣能量。
重击·编织的梦之童话和重击·编织的梦之魇影持续期间，梦铃的祷声获取效率提升。
chains.descEn:
Lily additionally gains 170 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of Dream Perfume upon entering combat, triggered once every 12s. When Lily deals DMG with Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom, she additionally gains 170 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=2} of Dream Perfume.
Casting Resonance Liberation - Into the Dream Cradle additionally restores 10 points of Concerto Energy.
Dealing DMG with Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale or Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End additionally restores 10 points of Resonance Energy.
During Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale or Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm, Lily gains Dreambell Chime faster.

chains.name: 愿您的过往沉入静港
chains.nameEn: May Your Past Sink into Silence
chains.desc: 梦乡提供的治疗量提升30%。

chains.name: 愿您安息于无垠辉光
chains.nameEn: May You Find Peace in Endless Light
chains.desc: 莉莉进入梦乡期间，队伍中的角色施放变奏技能时，牵引目标的范围扩大50%。
chains.descEn: While Lily is in Slumberland, the pull-in effect range is increased by 50% when a Resonator in the team casts Intro Skill.

chains.name: 愿我的美梦永不落幕
chains.desc: 重击·梦之童话的落幕、重击·梦之魇影的终结造成的衍射伤害额外提升100%，变奏技能·永绽造成的衍射伤害额外提升700%。
chains.descEn:
The Spectro DMG dealt by Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale, Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End is additionally increased by 100%.
The Spectro DMG dealt by Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom is additionally increased by 700%.
